reviews.review: Broken, unoptimissed piece of crap of game, they won't even give refund after 4 hours of not playing, but trying to fix bloody game. RIP STEAM

The developers force-install DLC content with update "patches." Bohemia has a DLC fixation - like, they've taken overpriced DLC to whole new levels of absurdity - so as a result it seems like you spend more time updating Arma 3 than you do playing it.

So today, what do I see? Yet another 8 GB DLC force-downloaded to the game with all the in-game advertisement that entails (the junk DLC content will show up among the base game's content in the armory and such, and literally spams your screen with logos if you mistakenly select it).

This time, though, it's a real kicker. A freaking 8 GB download for a DLC whose main selling point is a van. Not just any van, you see, but a MULTIPURPOSE van (it has different skins). It's a "non-combat, humanitarian-themed" DLC featuring ambulances and....ambulances....and...other stuff that nobody actually cares about.

I mean, it's not like there's a lack of areas in the base game that could have used some improvement or anything (there are). So their focus is building stupid DLC packs like this that have nothing to do with the actual gameplay people bought ARMA 3 for? This DLC bloat should not be FORCED onto my hard drive. I don't want it, I don't need it, and it offers nothing of value to me whatsoever. It should be an optional purchase and install. You're wasting my time and my disk space with your bloated 8 GB ambulances.

Mod creators can fit entire campaigns, storylines, and total-conversion packs into half the space Bohemia has taken up with its latest bloatware forced-download "patch." It's ridiculous. This push for forced-DLC downloads is anti-consumer and any game party to it gets a big, red thumbs down from me.

It is fun. We were on a custom server for about 2 months but then it got over populated and only the guys with cannons on their trucks or gun ships were getting any missions done. Either way, still fun if you can get past the bugs.

BEST GAME EVER 10/10 




Give u the experience of a real soldier
